rationale: This is structurally identical to the archived QualityIndexProfit with both legs swapped for their already-tested upgraded versions, so it is a recombination of known components rather than a new mechanism, and SUMRANK-averaging a strong conservatism leg with a rollover leg whose standalone alpha (4.8%) already exceeds the index's is more likely to dilute than to add.

This is a legitimate internal-consistency repair — MA(xrd,5) is exactly the straight-line amortization matching a five-year TS_SUM stock, so numerator and denominator now use the same capitalization convention — and it is genuinely diagnostic, since for steady-state R&D spenders the numerator collapses back toward reported EBIT and thus cleanly isolates whether the intangible premium is an addback artifact.

The hypothesis claims both gross-basis corrections are applied to the profitability ratio, but the expression's denominator (at + R&D stock) never restores accumulated depreciation, so the stated "consistent definition of invested capital" is not what the expression computes; it is also a two-component swap on the already-tested AgeAdjustedProfitConservatism/PolicyRate pair.

This is FloorRestoredProfitConservatism (fmb 6.30, Sharpe 0.461) with the net-base depreciation rate swapped for the gross-base version already tested in PolicyRateConservatismProfit — a single-component substitution whose likely outcome is a small interpolation between two known results, i.e., a cosmetic variant rather than a new economic test.

The pairing of tax-expense validation with a gross-base depreciation policy rate is a coherent and previously untested cell with a real economic tension (heavy book depreciation should suppress book-tax conformity), but tax/assets is close to a rescaled pretax profitability measure and edges toward the known book-tax-difference / tax-expense-surprise literature, so its incremental content is uncertain.

Stability of the depreciation rate is a genuinely different construct from its level or direction and is a useful interpretive discriminator, though the reviewer should note that VOL over only three annual observations of an age-contaminated net-base ratio will mechanically penalize firms with trending (aging or acquisitive) asset bases, and prior volatility-conditioner cells in this archive have produced weak or negative alphas.
